subject: Unexpected 429s — containment summary and customer briefing
messages:
From: Alex Kim <akim@cloudhaven.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@cloudhaven.com
Date: 2027-05-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Spike of 429s starting 08:50 PDT — impact on /generate endpoint

Hi Soojin,

We started seeing a sudden wave of 429 responses to our /generate calls around 08:50 PDT this morning. Error rate climbed to ~18% for about 20 minutes and caused our downstream worker queue to back up. Sample request IDs: req_7f8a2c, req_7f8a9e; timestamps in logs show 2027-05-17T08:50:12Z.

We're on Redwood hosted inference, region us-west-2. Can you confirm whether this is an account-level quota or a platform-wide issue? We also opened an internal ticket in case it's on our side but wanted to escalate here given customer impact.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Kim
Head of Engineering — CloudHaven
akim@cloudhaven.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Kim <akim@cloudhaven.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spike of 429s starting 08:50 PDT — impact on /generate endpoint

Thanks Alex — we see the same error traces in our monitoring. I'm opening an ops page now and tagging SRE. Initial read: a recent rate-cap rollout included a sliding-window translation that can produce a 1–3s enforcement offset between regions under certain burst patterns; that could cause transient 429s as bursts align against tighter windows.

Immediate ask to SRE (Sean): can you confirm whether we rolled a config across us-west-2 at ~08:45 and whether any tenant overrides were applied? If confirmed, please execute the following containment actions:
- temporarily widen enforcement window for tenant cloudhaven by +50% for 1 hour
- enable per-tenant soft-limit so we return Queueing instead of hard 429s during the window
- collect full request traces and attach incident-timeline.csv for customer

Alex — we'll follow up in 20–30 minutes with containment status.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Customer Reliability Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Kim <akim@cloudhaven.com>, eng-team@cloudhaven.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-17T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood update — containment in place, immediate mitigation, and credits

Hi Alex / CloudHaven team,

Quick update and next steps after triage:

What we observed
- Time window: ~08:50–09:12 PDT (we've attached incident-timeline.csv)
- Symptom: sudden increase in 429s on /generate; error spikes correlated with tight enforcement windows during a burst of short requests
- Scope: impacted only requests routed to us-west-2 and only tenants using the new rate-cap translation path; CloudHaven showed highest error rate due to burst pattern.

What we did (containment)
- Rolled back the sliding-window translation that shipped earlier this week across us-west-2 (completed 09:00 PDT)
- Applied a temporary per-tenant enforcement window override for CloudHaven (+50%) for 1 hour (completed 09:05 PDT)
- Enabled soft-limit behavior for CloudHaven so requests were queued instead of failing during the override
- Collected traces and logs; attached incident-timeline.csv and remediation-checklist.pdf

Current status
- Error rates have returned to baseline for CloudHaven; our monitoring shows <0.5% 429s since 09:10 PDT
- We are keeping the per-tenant override in place until 10:05 PDT while we validate stability

Customer remediation and compensation
- We're offering CloudHaven a one-time credit equal to 5% of May usage for the impacted endpoints. If you prefer credits applied to June invoice, let us know.

Next steps (post-incident)
- Root-cause analysis: engineering will investigate the translation logic and add a canary test to catch enforcement-window offsets during rollouts
- Permanent fix ETA: target patch release on 2027-05-20 subject to verification
- Postmortem: scheduled internal writeup and a short customer-facing summary to be delivered by EOD 2027-05-18

We'd like to schedule a 30-minute briefing to walk through the timeline and planned fixes. Suggested times: 2027-05-17 13:00 PDT or 2027-05-18 09:00 PDT. Please let us know which works.

Attachments: incident-timeline.csv (request traces), remediation-checklist.pdf (containment steps performed)

Apologies for the disruption — we'll keep you updated and make sure this doesn't recur.

Best regards,
Soojin Lee
Customer Reliability Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

From: Alex Kim <akim@cloudhaven.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@cloudhaven.com, eng-team@cloudhaven.com
Date: 2027-05-17T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood update — containment in place, immediate mitigation, and credits

Thanks Soojin — we see the errors subside and queues draining. Appreciate the rapid rollback and the per-tenant override. 13:00 PDT works for a short briefing today; if you can also share the incident-timeline.csv ahead of the call that would help.

One operational request: can you add a short-lived metric tag so we can filter our aggregate logs for requests that hit the overridden path? That will make post-incident verification easier on our side.

Thanks,
Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal follow-up — postmortem plan and rollout schedule

Internal note (not to be sent to customer):

Root cause summary: an off-by-one interpretation in the rate-cap translation module caused enforcement windows to be calculated with a 2s offset under burst alignment across multiple AZs. The offset only materialized for tenants with frequent short requests (CloudHaven pattern) and when the new translation path was live.

Planned fixes and timeline:
- Code fix for translation math: PR in review, target merge 2027-05-18 17:00 PDT
- Canary rollout with synthetic bursts to us-west-2: 2027-05-19 02:00 PDT (low traffic)
- Full rollout with automated rollback if 429 > 1% during canary: 2027-05-20 03:00 PDT
- Monitoring improvements: add enforcement-window delta metric, add canary test to CI, alert if delta > 1s for > 5m.

Compensation: confirm 5% credit and prepare customer-facing postmortem for 2027-05-18 EOD.

Marissa
VP, Customer Operations (internal)
